ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area with approximately 5-10% high-intensity (white) pixels localized at the margins and linear disruptions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive contiguous black pigmentation across the visible ventral surface. High-intensity white pixels are concentrated along the trailing edge margins and in a network of linear intersecting marks across the mid-lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 50-60 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations present along the entire trailing boundary. Right lobe distal margin exhibits extreme raggedness and deep localized indentations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the proximal edges transitioning to a sharp, tapered distal sweep terminating in jagged points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, high-contrast white circular clusters visible on the outer tips of both lobes and sporadically along the leading edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of white, non-parallel linear pixel tracks (rake marks) cutting through the dark ventral pigmentation on the left and central lobe regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks visible as high-contrast linear scars. Right lobe tip shows evidence of significant irregular tissue erosion or extreme serration.
